description: Plan a beat-synced montage: carve a detect_beats grid into shots every N beats (merging short and splitting long spans), assign clips in order, and emit add_to_timeline_batch chunks, trim ranges, and cut markers. Local-only and deterministic; never changes Premiere.

allow_reuse.description: When true, cycle through clips again once they run out (continuing from where each stopped); otherwise the montage stops.

audio_track_index.description: Target audio track for linked audio; defaults to 0.

beat_seconds.description: Strictly ascending beat times in sequence seconds, such as beatTimesSeconds from detect_beats.

clips.description: Source clips available for the montage, in the caller's preferred order.

in_seconds.description: Source in point in seconds; defaults to 0.

item_id.description: Project item node ID or unique name.

priority.description: Optional priority; higher values are used first in priority and round_robin orders.

frame_rate.description: Sequence frame rate used to snap shot boundaries; defaults to 30.

max_shot_seconds.description: Longer spans split at intermediate beats; defaults to 6.

min_shot_seconds.description: Shorter spans merge with the next beats; defaults to 0.4.

order.description: Clip assignment order; defaults to as_given. round_robin interleaves priority groups.

start_beat_index.description: Index of the first beat to cut on; defaults to 0.

total_duration_seconds.description: Optional cap on montage length measured from the first cut.

video_track_index.description: Target video track for every placement; defaults to 0.

name: plan_beat_montage

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Plan Beat Montage
